name: Napa Valley
summary: Napa Valley is California's most famous wine region, a long valley of vineyards and grand estates an hour north of San Francisco. Taste Cabernet at historic wineries, ride the Wine Train, soak in the mud baths of Calistoga, eat at world-class restaurants in Yountville and float over the vines in a sunrise balloon.
seasonNote: Harvest (crush) is September and October; spring has green vines and fewer crowds.
arrival: About 1 hour 15 minutes by car from San Francisco.
gettingAround: Book a driver or tour if tasting; bike the Vine Trail.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants.
baseArea: Napa town, Yountville or St. Helena

connections.note: Or by ferry to Vallejo then bus.
